items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Spain, we were very lucky to practically, but maybe other people had a different opinion, to be discovered by Spanish. We were the best friend, the sweetheart of Spain

ctx.x: Well, let me tell you. Ah - we had a - even an entire black family had a great European influence because Spain, we were very lucky to practically, but maybe

other people had a different opinion, to be discovered by Spanish. We were the best friend, the sweetheart of Spain; like when Spain lost Cuba, America, the United States, fall in love with Cuba. We had from the United States everything. Now you could see what is going on.

But, what I am driving at is that I notice that in the United States becoming a boxer or a basketball player or a baseball player, seems to be the way out of the ghetto. Was it the same thing over there? Music for the Afro-Cuban? Was this a chance for you to rise to a better status?
